name: Misa
message: 「You couldn't possibly be hungry, right? Not after eating all those sweets」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets go into a separate stomach! My actual stomach is totally starving」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So what you're saying is that the Treasurer's stomach is a bottomless pit, yes?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the last person I want to hear that from」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're hungry... here, have a kashiwa mochi\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「There aren't even any lights on, so I doubt it's sports club practice... Who could that be at this hour?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got a bad feeling about this. Guys, please」
My bad premonition was dead on.
Several demons with familiar appearances. They were prowling around the academy.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it seems the demons have come to play once again.」

name: Misa
message: 「Who is it this time? The Ready-to-Lose-Gracefully Squad?」

name: Ria
message: 「These ones... are different from the usual demons!」
Normally, a handful like this would be scurrying around restlessly, going this way and that as they pleased.
However, this time, they are lined up in neat ranks, staring straight at us without breaking formation.
Without uttering a word, the demons begin radiating an ominous aura.
Magical power is overflowing from every joint of their bodies.
They don't seem to have the slightest interest in exchanging words.

name: Synn
message: 「Guess we get 'em before they get us!」
